0.name: beginState
0.desc:
Begins an action (ANV start).

Specify the action name here.

Must be paired with ActionEnd().

2.name: sprite
2.desc:
Begins a sprite/cell block.

Specifies the sprite/animation and duration (frames).

Commands inside execute during this time.

3.name: endLabel
3.desc:
Explicitly indicates the end of the CellBegin group.

May be used for loop control, etc.

6.name: ifOperation
6.desc:
Begins an IF condition using an OP2 comparison.

Stores result in a temporary variable.

7.name: ifNot
7.desc: Begins an IF condition with NOT logic.

8.name: ifOpponentCharacter
8.desc: Conditional branch based on enemy character name.

11.name: beginLabel
11.desc: Defines a label used as a jump destination.

13.name: gotoIfOperation
13.desc: Conditional jump using an OP2 comparison.

14.name: gotoLabelRequests
14.desc: Queued/reserved Goto that executes after the current processing block.

15.name: beginSubroutine
15.desc:
Begins a function/subroutine definition.

Must be paired with FuncEnd().

18.name: exitState
18.desc:
Terminates the action, same as ActionEnd().

(This command closes CellBegin)

22.name: endUpon
22.desc:
Indicates the end of the interrupt process.

See the basic section for details.

24.name: gotoLabelIf
24.desc: Conditional jump if operand evaluates true.

25.name: gotoLabelIfNot
25.desc: Conditional jump if operand evaluates false.

26.name: setSpriteTime
26.desc: Overrides the duration of the current sprite/cell.

27.name: jumpToState

28.desc: Requests a state change only if different from the current state.

30.name: ifPlayerCharacter
30.desc: Conditional branch based on player character name.

31.name: gotoForLoop
31.desc: Used to form loop-like control flow using conditional branching.

34.desc: Triggers an action via an interrupt.

39.name: ifOnFrame

Frame-based conditional branching.

Equivalent to checking current frame timing.

49.name: checkMoveFlag

Clamps a value within a given range.

51.name: isObjectActive

Result stored in a temporary variable.

71.desc: Removes the stack if self is stacked.

Saves the speed in the X direction to a temporary area.

Used in air moves for effects where the character stops momentarily and then returns to the original speed.

147.desc: Sets the default gravity for air damage.

Ignores some speed processing (time-specified). 1. Application of speed, 2. Application of gravity. Elements may increase later.

235.name: recoveryState

・Attack will no longer hit.

・Will no longer have counter-hit property.

・Acceptance of cancels ends.

These effects occur.

1558.name: cpuEstimateTagGuard
1558.desc: Solidify: High evaluation against guarding opponents.

1559.name: cpuEstimateTagCombo
1559.desc: For combos: High evaluation against damaged opponents.

1560.name: cpuEstimateTagPunish
1560.desc: Poke: High evaluation against opponents who are neither guarding nor damaged.

1561.name: cpuEstimateTagXNearPunish
1561.desc: Poke at close range: Move to poke at close range. Affects evaluation when opponent is in neutral state. Evaluation increases or decreases with distance.

1562.name: cpuEstimateTagXFarPunish
1562.desc: Poke at long range: Move to poke at long range. Affects evaluation when opponent is in neutral state. Evaluation increases or decreases with distance.

1563.name: cpuEstimateTagXMidPunish
1563.desc: Poke at mid range: Move to poke at mid range. Affects evaluation when opponent is in neutral state. Evaluation increases or decreases with distance.

1564.name: cpuEstimateTagKiten
1564.desc: Starting move: Tag to attach to general purpose moves like 5A. Evaluation increases on reversal or at close range. Generally has high evaluation.

1565.name: cpuIsOverhead
1565.desc: Mid: High evaluation against guarding opponents and opponents who have been crouching for a long time. (No using immediately upon seeing)

1566.name: cpuIsLow
1566.desc: Low: High evaluation against guarding opponents and opponents who have been standing for a long time.

1567.name: cpuIsThrow
1567.desc: Throw: High evaluation against opponents in a throw-vulnerable state.

1568.name: cpuIsTaiku
1568.desc: Anti-air: High evaluation against airborne opponents, especially those not in a damaged state.

1569.name: cpuUsesResource
1569.desc: Use Resource: Normally refrain from using. Evaluation increases when time is running out or when about to lose.

1570.name: cpuBigDamage
1570.desc: Big Damage: Evaluation against opponent's vulnerable tag increases. Evaluation also increases when losing.

1571.name: cpuEstimateTagKugurare
1571.desc: Can be ducked under: Increases evaluation of opponent's duck tag.

1572.name: cpuEstimateTagKuguri
1572.desc: Duck: Evaluation increases when the frequency of the can be ducked under tag is high.

1573.name: cpuEstimateTagTobare
1573.desc: Can be jumped over: Increases evaluation of opponent's jump tag. Mainly set for projectiles.

1574.name: cpuEstimateTagTobi
1574.desc: Jump: Evaluation increases when the frequency of the can be jumped over tag is high.

1575.name: cpuEstimateTagInvuln
1575.desc: Invincible: Evaluation increases on wake-up, after guarding, and when being hit unilaterally.

1576.name: cpuEstimateTagProjectileInvuln
1576.desc: Projectile Invincible: Evaluation increases when the frequency of the projectile tag is high.

1577.name: cpuEstimateTagProjectile
1577.desc: Projectile: Increases evaluation of opponent's projectile invincible tag.

1578.name: cpuEstimateTagSukidarake
1578.desc: Vulnerable: When used, the evaluation of Rapid Cancel and Super Cancel increases. Increases evaluation of opponent's Big Damage tag.

1579.name: cpuEstimateTagKunage
1579.desc: Air Throw: High evaluation against opponents in a throw-vulnerable state.

1580.name: cpuEstimateTagGamenhashi
1580.desc: Screen Edge Limited: High evaluation when cornering the opponent at the screen edge. Not used otherwise.

1581.name: cpuEstimateTagFromDash
1581.desc: Perform from Dash: Evaluation increases during dash, and decreases otherwise.

1582.name: cpuEstimateTagNoCombo
1582.desc: Does not use when opponent is damaged.

1583.name: cpuEstimateTagNoAirCombo
1583.desc: Does not use when opponent is damaged in the air. Stagger, etc. are used normally.

1584.name: cpuEstimateMomBoss
1584.desc:
Often used in Berserk state. //red_okamoto2015/08/21 Sealed.

memo Does not evaluate (use) the specified skill.

1585.name: cpuDoNotEstimate
1585.desc: Does not evaluate (use). However, can be used as part of a stylish combo slot or recipe.

1588.name: cpuTagOnHighEstimateOnly
1588.desc: Only evaluated when high evaluation processing (SkillEstExHighEstimation) is called. Used for combo parts, etc.

1589.name: cpuEstimateTagNamepu
1589.desc: For teasing. Only used when weak at a certain level or below.
